title.narrative: Lebanon Financing Facility for Reform, Recovery and Reconstruction MultiDonor Trust Fund

description.narrative: The objective of the Trust Fund is to support immediate socio-economic recovery of vulnerable people and businesses following the explosion in Beirut on August 4, 2020 and to build the foundations for medium-term recovery and the sustainable reconstruction of the Port of Beirut and affected neighborhoods.
